career_stats_definition: Official senior club career only. Youth, reserve and national-team rows are excluded from career appearances, goals and assists.
club_count_definition: Distinct senior first-team clubs with an official senior appearance.
trophy_definition: Recognized senior team trophies only; individual and youth awards excluded.
publication_policy: Only 9/9 completed records are playable. This first release intentionally uses a small verified core instead of padding the pool with uncertain values.
primary_data_policy: Transfermarkt-first; Maçkolik/other reputable sources used only for missing fields and cross-checks.

sources.physical_fallback: EAFC26/SoFIFA where Transfermarkt does not provide weight
